svg.desc: A4 top-view mounting reference. Origin at PCB envelope centre; X right, Y up; coordinates in millimetres.
svg.text: Mechanical reference / PCB envelope + mounting centres
Origin at PCB bounding-box centre. +X right; +Y up. Top view
Rectangle = PCB envelope. Edge radii, cutouts and
Dimensions govern. Tolerances are not specified.
A4 / Print at 100% / Do not fit to page
